tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search AliExpress for products, prices and alternatives. Returned links are affiliate links.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get product details, variants, prices, shipping and catalogue availability for search results. Keep the search country and currency. Use include_media for all picture links and available video. Returned links are affiliate links.

tools.name: show_pictures
tools.description: Show original product pictures in chat. One ID shows all its pictures; several IDs show one per product in order.
